summary: Project Orbit is an interactive, space-themed educational game that challenges players to design, launch, and operate an Earth-observation satellite. Players take on the role of a spacecraft engineer, making decisions about satellite components, power requirements, fuel capacity, communication systems, and launch vehicles. Through a series of progressively challenging missions, the game introduces fundamental concepts of satellite engineering, orbital operations, and Earth observation in an engaging, hands-on environment. By combining interactive 3D environments with mission-based gameplay, Project Orbit makes complex space science concepts more accessible and enjoyable.
details: Project Orbit features a multi-stage gameplay experience that takes players from spacecraft assembly to live orbital operations. Players begin by selecting and configuring satellite components, including imaging instruments, solar arrays, batteries, antennas, and propulsion systems. Each configuration must satisfy specific mission requirements, such as payload mass limits, electrical power demands, and budget constraints, before an appropriate launch vehicle can be selected. Once launched, players operate their spacecraft in a simulated low Earth orbit, where they must identify survey zones, collect observation data, manage available power and fuel, and transmit collected information during designated ground communication windows. The game includes six missions of increasing difficulty, covering scenarios such as coastal mapping, wetland monitoring, storm response, wildfire observation, and glacier profiling. A mission evaluation system provides performance scores and engineering feedback, allowing players to understand the consequences of their design and operational decisions.
